question: 'Church' is related to 'Christians' in the same way 'Synagogue' is related to '________'.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

__
 
• A church is a place of worship for Christians.

Similarly, 

 
• A synagogue is a place of worship for Jews.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Muslims - a place of worship is Mosque
 
• Jains - a place of worship is Derasar
 
• Parsis - a place of worship is Agyari

Hence, **"Jews"** is the correct answer.
